verses.text: <pb/><e>Abù Ọma ikele ekele.</e> <pb/><t>Tikusienu Johova nkpu ọṅù ike, uwa nile.</t>
<t>Werenu ọṅù fè Jehova òfùfè:</t> <t>Werenu iti-nkpu ọṅù bia n'iru Ya.</t>
<t>Maranu na Jehova, Ya onwe-ya bu Chineke:</t> <t>Ya onwe-ya emewo ayi, ọ bu kwa Ya nwe ayi;</t> <t>Ayi bu ndi-Ya, na ìgwè aturu nke ọzùzù-anu-Ya.</t>
<t>Werenu ekele ba n'ọnu-uzọ-ama-Ya nile,</t> <t>Werenu otuto ba n'ogige-Ya nile:</t> <t>Kelenu Ya, gọzi-kwa-nu aha-Ya.</t>
<t>N'ihi na Jehova di nma; rue mb͕e ebighi-ebi ka ebere-Ya di;</t> <t>Rue ọb͕ọ nile ka ikwesi-ntukwasi-obi-Ya di kwa.</t>
